## Crafting

Price revision: **3**.

| Base Essence setting | F | E | D | C | B | A |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Upgrade coefficient × target level | 1 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 8 | 13 |
| Evolve coefficient × √current level | 10 | 40 | 90 | 160 | 250 | — |
| Guaranteed Scrap return | 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50 | 60 |
| Reroll one perk + one matching Dice | — | 30 | 50 | 70 | 100 | 140 |

Max Out: **500 Essence + one Mythical Gem** for the whole clothing item. This fee has no Crafting or Luck discount. Evolution rounds the base coefficient × √level up before applying Rarity. See [Crafting](../quest-mining/completion/rpg-attributes/crafting.md).

## Lootboxes And Potions

Drop-policy revision: **0** (0 uses the server defaults). Common-box won item cards have a **1%** potion branch. Higher boxes contain clothing only.

| Rarity | Clothing frequency | Potion frequency | Conditional potion chance | Potion restore | Potion weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F | 1 | 1 | 60.25% | 10% | 100 g |
| E | 5 | 2.5 | 24.1% | 30% | 174 g |
| D | 25 | 6.25 | 9.64% | 90% | 241 g |
| C | 125 | 15.625 | 3.86% | 270% | 303 g |
| B | 625 | 39.0625 | 1.54% | 810% | 362 g |
| A | 3,125 | 97.65625 | 0.62% | 2,430% | 419 g |

Larger frequency means lower probability; 0 disables a potion rarity. The potion chance in the table is conditional on the potion branch. Clothing uses its integer ticket calculation above the box rarity floor; see [Potions](../quest-mining/completion/rpg-items/potions.md#acquisition).

## Gem Leaderboard

Settings revision: **1**; rules version: **1**.

No reward: **0/1 ≈ 0%**. Each rarity percentage applies to the remaining buyers, rounded up; A takes the final remainder.

| Rarity | Share of remaining buyers | First unique-buyer count |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F — Common | 2/3 ≈ 66.67% | 1 |
| E — Uncommon | 2/3 ≈ 66.67% | 3 |
| D — Rare | 2/3 ≈ 66.67% | 9 |
| C — Epic | 2/3 ≈ 66.67% | 27 |
| B — Legendary | 2/3 ≈ 66.67% | 81 |
| A — Mythical | 1/1 ≈ 100% | 243 |

The time multiplier falls linearly from **1.1×** at Monday 00:00 UTC to **1×** at week end. Trading Liquidity also applies.

Activation and sales availability are separate from these prize percentages. See [Gems](../quest-mining/completion/rpg-items/gems.md).

## Consensus

Revision: **1**. Each voter contributes **√level** trust. Both quorum requirements must be met.

| Scenario | Minimum participants | Minimum trust |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quest rating | 3 | 6 |
| Initial moderation | 2 | 6 |
| Appeal I / First Quest Review | 4 | 18 |
| Final appeal | 7 | 54 |

Changes apply to new cases and rating rounds. See [Consensus](../quest-mining/moderation/consensus.md).

## Stamina Reference

A fresh unequipped character has **2,208 Stamina**, recovers **4.6/minute**, and has a base quest cost of **32**. Overflow decays at **25% of Maximum Stamina/hour**. These server parameters are separate from Admin crafting prices. See [Stamina](../quest-mining/completion/rpg-attributes/stamina.md).
